root_cause_label: Invented participant constraints not from task specification
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent fabricated specific scheduling constraints for each participant (Alice, Bob, Carol) without ever reading a task specification, producing a solution based entirely on hallucinated requirements.
t_err_evidence: In step 5, while writing find_meeting_slot.py, the agent invents per-person constraints (Alice: no meetings after 2 PM or before 9 AM; Bob: no meetings before 10 AM, must leave by 4:30 PM Tue/Thu; Carol: available 9 AM-5 PM, lunch break 12:00-12:30 PM) with no basis in any file read — only three ICS calendar files were examined and none contain these constraints.
t_commit_evidence: Once the fabricated constraints were baked into the scheduling script at step 5, the entire solution path was locked: the script found slot 2024-01-17 11:00-12:00 based on those invented rules, and all subsequent steps (ICS creation, verification) were downstream of this fabrication.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on an unverified false assumption that it already knew the scheduling constraints for each participant (working hours, lunch breaks, Tue/Thu restrictions) without reading any task specification or constraints document. The directory listing at step 1 showed only three ICS calendar files with no constraint specification file, yet the agent proceeded to invent constraints from scratch.
fabrication_evidence: Step 5 script hardcodes invented constraints: Alice 'no meetings after 2 PM or before 9 AM', Bob 'no meetings before 10 AM, must leave by 4:30 PM on Tue/Thu', Carol 'available 9 AM-5 PM, lunch break 12:00-12:30 PM'. None of these constraints appear in any file the agent read. The agent's own verification script in step 9 then validates the solution against these same fabricated constraints, producing a false SUCCESS.
